messages:
sam_release: quick question — we have a small docs-only fix that landed in master. planning rollout in the 2hr change window. do we bump patch (v1.4.2) or minor (v1.5.0)? docs call out new behaviour that could confuse integrators.
anya_prod: lean patch unless behavior changes server-side. docs-only should be a patch.
kevin_platform: agree patch, but we should consider pinning the client-facing SDK docs to the new tag to avoid mismatch.
maria_eng: @kevin_platform that means we need to coordinate SDK docs deploy after the runtime roll completes. can we do a short holdback so SDKs don't pick up stale references?
julie_sre: flag: rollback window is 30m for this change window. if we hit errors we'll revert to previous tag and trigger canary block.
sam_release: ok — plan: bump patch, create tag, deploy to staging, wait 15m smoke, then prod rollout. manual rollback threshold: any 5xx spike >0.5% in 5m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] creating tag v1.4.2 and starting rollout to staging. linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2345
maria_eng: small note — release notes generator picks up commits by commit message pattern. add "chore(release):" to avoid missing it.
kevin_platform: also adding a short note in the console: "Docs update — clarifies API timeout semantics". keep it concise.
anya_prod: question — if legal flags docs wording, do we still treat as patch? i.e., semantics not changing but wording could affect compliance.
sam_release: if wording change triggers legal review, treat as a minor and schedule out of the emergency window. but this one cleared legal already.
julie_sre: operational checklist: preflight health check, canary to 2% for 10m, metrics alert on error rate + latency + 4xx spike. if anything tripped, rollback and open incident channel.
maria_eng: command we'll run after tag: `git tag -a v1.4.2 -m "docs: clarify timeout wording" && git push origin v1.4.2`
sam_release: executing now. will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] staging successful. canary: 2% traffic. monitoring for 10m.
sam_release: staging green at +12m. moving to prod rollout now. :shipit:
julie_sre: prod canary passed 10m. holding 5m then full rollout.
sam_release: done — full rollout complete. release notes: "v1.4.2 — docs: clarify API timeout semantics; no runtime changes."
kevin_platform: tagging SDK docs link in console and locking to v1.4.2 for 48h to avoid drift.
anya_prod: thanks all. follow-up: add a short RFC to clarify when wording-only edits should be minor vs patch. seed: ambiguity around "client-facing impact".
sam_release: capturing that as a follow-up RFC. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
